newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-DRAGOMIR WINS CZECH OPEN TITLE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DRAGOMIR WINS CZECH OPEN TITLE.

text.p: Romania's Ruxanda Dragomir beat unseeded Swiss opponent Patty Schnyder 6-2 3-6 6-4 in the final of the rain-affected Czech Open tennis tournament on Sunday.
Schnyder, weary after her delayed semifinal against Czech Lenka Cenkova, fought back gallantly after losing the first set but eventually faded against the much-fresher Dragomir.
The combination of Czech Helena Sukova and Slovak Katarina Habsudova took the doubles title in a tournament interrupted on frequent occasions by rain.
